why.max_prompt_tokens: Measured 2026-10-25 on the lab's captured catalogue: 2,301 to 3,026 tokens (estimated, an over-estimate) for five questions, 20 metrics offered; 8,000 is about 2.6x, and the local tier's context (13.1).
